sources.title: Pointcept/Pointcept | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Pointcept is a comprehensive and flexible framework for point cloud perception research. It serves as the official implementation for several state-of-the-art approaches, including Utonia, Concerto, Sonata, Point Transformer V3 (PTv3), OA-CNNs, Point Prompt Training (PPT), and Masked Scene Contrast (MSC).
